name: Ekansh Concepts Limited
about: Ekansh Concepts Limited provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for infrastructure projects in India. The company offers its services for roads, bridges, tunnels, pipelines, runways, and highway projects, as well as water supply and sanitation, housing, urban development, solid waste management, public financial management reforms, and sustainable infrastructure development. It also provides end-to-end consulting services for infrastructure development projects; and professional services, including feasibility studies, detailed project reports, project management consultancy, independent engineer services, and technical advisory and infrastructure consulting services. The company serves government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), and other public authorities. The company was formerly known as Paramone Concepts Limited and changed its name to Ekansh Concepts Limited in June 2022. Ekansh Concepts Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
